note: The Atlas engine is built from the public Enntity/atlas fork at this exact commit; build.sh refuses any other tree.

upstream_candidate.note: upstream/glm53-flash-20261007-strings (GLM tool arguments keep their schema types; no effort header on the empty think block) plus copy (prompt-lookup) drafts beside DFlash2 (ATLAS_DFLASH_COPY_DRAFTS), the bare role-literal strip limited to ChatML models (GLM streamed replies lost the words tool/user/assistant), and Poolside tool-call headers held until the call validates.

sparkglm_only.note: The unchanged FlashKDA/native sparse-MLA prefill bridges and GB10 display-carveout KV placement from fdd2f965, then the carveout takes latent KV pools only (ATLAS_KV_CARVEOUT_ORDER, default latent): the GPU maps the carveout L2-uncached, and sparse-index buffers there slowed 64K cold prefill by 7% (Enntity/sparkglm#30). Fork-only; used only with DISPLAY_CARVEOUT=1. Plus: sharded latent pools (ATLAS_GLM_KV_SHARD, opt-in through SPARKGLM_KV_SHARD) size and place in the display carveout.

integration.note: sparkglm/atlas-20261009-final plus: the canonical verify (exp/canonical-verify: one row-invariant kernel family per op for every verify width, plain decode as a one-row verify, dense FFN included, so greedy output no longer depends on the DFlash width, the drafter or concurrency; ATLAS_GLM_CANONICAL_VERIFY, default on), persistent prefetching MoE decode kernels (exp/moe-decode-bw, bit-identical; ATLAS_GLM_MOE_DECODE_PERSIST, on in the profiles) and one-launch KDA record commits (exp/kda-commit-batch, bit-identical), cherry-picked with -x.
